project.name: Dragon Quest XI Interactive Story Web Application
project.description: สร้างเว็บแอปพลิเคชันสำหรับเล่นเรื่อง Dragon Quest XI แบบ interactive โดยผู้ใช้สามารถกดปุ่มเพื่อโต้ตอบกับเหตุการณ์และดำเนินเรื่องไปตามลำดับ
project.target_audience: Dragon Quest fans and RPG gamers

frontend.framework: Next.js 14+ with TypeScript and App Router
frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS with dark fantasy theme
frontend.animations: React Spring for smooth animations and transitions
frontend.routing: Next.js App Router for file-based routing
frontend.ui_components: Custom components with RPG aesthetics and React Spring animations

backend.api: Supabase JavaScript Client + Next.js API routes

database_schema.note: ใช้ Schema ที่ให้ไว้แล้ว - Supabase PostgreSQL

4_setup_tailwind.action: Configure Tailwind with custom DQ11 theme

config.animations: Custom animations for React Spring integration

features: Auto-create user profile on first login

LoginPage.design: Dragon Quest styled login form with React Spring animations

WorldMap.purpose: Display interactive world map with React Spring animations

features.map_display: Show regions with unlock status and hover animations
features.region_selection: Click to enter regions with spring transitions
features.responsive_design: Works on mobile and desktop with adaptive animations

WorldMap.animations: React Spring for region hover effects and selection transitions

LocationView.purpose: Show specific location with available events and smooth transitions

features.location_info: Display location name and description with fade-in animation
features.event_list: Show available story events with staggered entrance animations
features.progress_indicator: Animated completion status with progress bars
features.navigation: Back to world map with slide transition

EventInteraction.purpose: Handle story event interactions with React Spring animations

features.event_display: Show event name and description with typewriter effect
features.interaction_buttons: Animated Talk, Examine, Choose options with hover states
features.dialogue_system: Display character dialogues with slide-in animations
features.choice_system: Multiple choice selections with spring-powered emphasis

PartyDisplay.purpose: Show current party members with character animations

features.character_portraits: Display character images with floating animations
features.character_stats: HP, MP, Level display with number counting animations
features.party_management: Add/remove members with slide and fade animations
features.member_joining: Special animation when new character joins party

useGameProgress.purpose: Manage user's game progression with Zustand integration
useGameProgress.zustand_integration: Connect with gameStore for state management

features: Dragon Quest XI branding with React Spring entrance animations
Start New Game / Continue buttons with hover animations
User profile display with fade-in effect
Game instructions with staggered text animations

layout.header: User info, party status, current location with slide-down animation
layout.main_content: WorldMap or EventInteraction with smooth transitions
layout.sidebar: Party members, inventory with slide-in animations

GameDashboard.animations: Coordinated layout transitions using React Spring

features: Immersive event presentation with cinematic transitions
Character dialogue with portraits and typewriter animations
Interactive choice system with spring-powered selection
Progress saving with satisfying completion animations
StoryEventPage.dynamic_routing: Uses Next.js dynamic routing for event IDs

animations.page_transitions: Next.js page transitions with React Spring
animations.button_interactions: Scale and glow effects using React Spring useSpring
animations.character_introductions: Slide-in effects with useChain for coordinated timing
animations.dialogue_effects: Typewriter animations using React Spring's useSpringValue
animations.micro_interactions: Hover states, button presses, and feedback animations

save_system.description: Auto-save user progress with optimistic updates
save_system.implementation: Save after each interaction using Zustand middleware
save_system.storage: Supabase user_progress table with Next.js API routes for validation

responsive_design.breakpoints: Mobile, tablet, desktop optimized with React Spring responsive animations
responsive_design.interactions: Touch-friendly on mobile with spring-powered gesture support

loading_states.description: Proper loading indicators with React Spring
loading_states.implementation: Skeleton screens with shimmer effects and smooth transitions
loading_states.user_experience: Never leave users wondering - animated feedback for all actions

state_persistence.description: Zustand state persistence across page reloads
state_persistence.implementation: Persist important game state to localStorage with Zustand middleware
state_persistence.sync: Sync with Supabase on state changes

user_experience.progress_indication: Always show where user is in the story
user_experience.accessibility: Keyboard navigation and screen reader support

performance.loading_optimization: Next.js Image optimization and lazy loading with React Spring fade-ins
performance.caching: Next.js built-in caching + Zustand state caching
performance.bundle_size: Tree-shaking with Next.js and selective React Spring imports
performance.database_queries: Efficient queries with minimal round trips + Next.js API route caching
performance.animation_performance: Hardware-accelerated animations with React Spring's will-change optimization

interaction_examples: Talk to Erik in prison cell

working_web_application.story_progression: Users can progress through Dragon Quest XI story
working_web_application.party_system: Characters join party based on story events
